=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2015-2016, 3160-3168 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic issue-comment path remains unreachable because its outer guard checks `GH_TOKEN` after it has been unset, preventing the inner command-level restore from running.
  WHY: After `GH_TOKEN` is unset, the guard evaluates false, so diagnostic issue comments are skipped on implement-run failure paths.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1065-1109 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The comprehensive-marker binding chain can proceed to bind a malformed or unselected marker without first validating its shape.
  WHY: The reported path allows the downstream tracking-comment input to contain an invalid marker and be posted as an unsigned marker.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1118-1122 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When marker binding fails, the tracking issue is closed without recording the failure reason on the issue, leaving later dispatcher runs unable to distinguish this close from a manual close.
  WHY: The failure stage is written only to workflow logs, so the next dispatcher may skip the issue or attempt to bind the closed issue.
- .github/workflows/{clarify,plan,implement,orchestrate,orchestrate_clarify_respond,orchestrate_poll,review_autofix,check_failure_triage,cancel_on_pr_close,validate,sync_ai_labels}.yml (and `internal-{clarify,plan,implement,orchestrate-clarify-respond,orchestrate,orchestrate-poll,review,validate,check-failure-triage,workflow-failure-heal}.yml` not in the diff):every `for f in …` block under "Stage workflow support files" plus the matching "Resolve workflow support ref" step | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new immutable-SHA and fail-fast support-file resolution removes the prior fallback behavior, so consumer repos pinned to older refs that lack newly required helpers can no longer dispatch phases.
  WHY: The ref resolver now rejects values that are not 40-character lowercase hex and exits on missing scripts, prompts, or staging failures instead of using the prior snapshot fallback.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2008-2034 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If the process-group file is removed mid-attempt while the writer-launched flag remains true, the EXIT trap can fail verification and exit 80 after per-attempt cleanup has already completed.
  WHY: The reported later-iteration trap path verifies a missing process-group file and exits before the original failure path can complete.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:113 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The remaining `fetch_from_ref_or_local` call refers to an undefined function, preventing `ingest_implement_plan_lessons.py` from being staged.
  WHY: The script is consequently absent from `_fetched_scripts` and `${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR}`, so lessons ingestion is skipped for affected PR merges.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:560-580, 638-654 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Removing the curl fallback means Telegram alerts and cleanup fail when trusted Telegram helper scripts are unavailable.
  WHY: The alert step still runs under `if: always()`, but exits 1 when `scripts/tg_helpers.sh` is missing, so no PR-merged Telegram alert is sent.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:572-584 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The credential helper written to `$GITHUB_ENV` supplies `GH_TOKEN` for any git credential request in subsequent steps, rather than limiting credentials to the origin remote.
  WHY: Subsequent git operations against other GitHub hosts or repositories can receive the GH_PAT credential, broadening the credential scope beyond memory helper clones.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
